verdict.rationale: Auth0 FGA is documented as a relationship-based authorization platform that decouples complex authorization logic from code, and it is shown enforcing document-level (resource-level) access control, which goes beyond the role assignments of Auth0 RBAC. The evidence is short first-party marketing and AI-docs snippets, so how authorization models, relationship tuples and policies are actually expressed and checked is not shown. Missing for 10: documentation of the FGA modeling language and its relationship or policy definitions, general resource-level check APIs outside RAG, how FGA integrates with core Auth0 tenants, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can express fine-grained, resource-level authorization (relationship- or policy-based) beyond simple roles

citations.quote: Auth0 FGA provides a unified, relationship-based platform that helps secure multi-tenant B2B APIs and apps, and decouples complex authorization logic from your code.
Enforce fine-grained, document-level access control within your Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using Auth0 FGA.
tap into advanced authorization mechanics for more flexible access control
